Derived from unit-type-map.json (the 5.0.2 table) on 2026-09-03: identical except the five AR Scout rows, which name a C2simEx-only template and were re-pointed at stock 5.2d templates (see their proxyNote). 5.2d .entity files publish 7-field types; the objectType column keeps the 8-field form (superType 3 = kind 11 unit, else 1) that the app and the bridge speak - ObjectTypeResolver normalises on read. Every row was resolved against the 5.2d chain by the sec-2.3 best-match rule; --typemap-selftest with VRF_HOME=C:\MAK\vrforces5.2d re-proves it.
notes: objectType is the EIGHT-field VR-Forces type (superType:Kind:Domain:Country:Category:Subcategory:Specific:Extra) exactly as it appears in the .entity files. superType 3 = disaggregated unit (aggregate), 1 = individual (entity); it MUST agree with isAggregate. The app strips it and hands the 7 DIS fields to the bridge, which prepends it again.

fidelity EXACT = a real composed template of the right branch AND echelon. PROXY = a real composed template of the wrong branch, echelon or nation - surfaced to C2SIM per R-SURFACE-PROXY. AUTHORED_PENDING = nothing usable exists; the lookup FAILS LOUDLY and the unit is NOT created (emitting anything here lands a zero-subordinate Country-0 abstract or Ground_Aggregate, which is worse than nothing - survey sec 3.5).
functionId is SIDC positions 5-10 (0-based 4..9) with trailing '-' trimmed. '' = the echelon-only fallback row (key d). '(none)' = the SIDC function-ID field is blank (COA-STP1 group 43, HHC).
echelon is the SIDC echelon/mobility modifier at position 12 (0-based 11), verbatim - including '-' when the field is empty. '*' = the catch-all row.
echelonCode is the C2SIM Unit/EchelonCode enum, used only by key (c) as a cross-check when the SIDC echelon character does not resolve.
